name: Stevo's AI Blocklist
note: Regles non exprimables en Content Blocker WebKit mais exploitables par un moteur a injection (Safari Web Extension). Non chargeables telles quelles par Safari.

scriptlets.name: remove-attr
args: .search-input[placeholder="This is AI-powered search. Type a prompt."]

procedural.selector: .category-link-CHATBOT:style(visibility: hidden !important; height: 0 !important; width: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; font-size: 0 !important;)
.qiAA2Q:has-text("Start typing or ask Canva to generate"):upward(1):style(--new-text: "Start typing";)
.qiAA2Q:has-text("Start typing or ask Canva to generate"):style(font-size: 0px !important;)
li:has(> [data-tab-item="agents"]):style(max-width: 0px !important; margin-left: calc(0px - var(--stack-gap-condensed,.5rem)) !important; visibility: hidden !important;)
.block-promo-banner:has-text(Let AI help you find the perfect domain name)
#docs-banner-container:has-text(Upgrade to elevate your videos with AI custom clips with Veo, voiceovers, and more)
#gen-qa > .gen-q:has-text(Do you have a wacky AI that can write memes for me?)
#gen-qa > p:has-text(Funny you ask. Why yes, we do. Here you go:)
#flash-messages > .error:has-text("Can't complete code. Error code: Failed to fetch.")
.no-results > p:has-text(You can hit Enter to ask AI a given question)
[slot="comment"] p > a.border-dotted:style(border: none !important; color: inherit !important; cursor: auto !important; padding: 0 !important;)
.new-question--alert-banner--OOMck li:has-text(Ask the AI Assistant for instant answers)
